results.content: DALLAS (KDAF) — The internet term “6-7” has emerged as the most searched slang phrase in the United States and one of the top terms in Texas in 2026, according to Google search analysis released by Unscramblerer.com. The study evaluated Google Trends search data from Jan. 1 to Aug. 17 to identify the slang terms generating the highest search interest nationwide and across Texas.
